newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 powers to new high on futures squeeze.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 powers to new high on futures squeeze.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 surged on Friday to a new record high on Friday with index futures powering ahead on a massive, post-budget squeeze, dealers said.
The index was 44.9 points up at 4,876.6 by 0828 GMT after hitting its previous high of 4,863.6 on Thursday, the day after the new Labour government's first budget.
The market interpreted Wednesday's budget favourably despite the view that measures to clamp down on buoyant consumer spending were insufficient to avoid imminent interest rate rises.
However analysts said the market sees near-term higher rates as ultimately good news with longer-term benefits from the consequent dampening of inflationary pressures.
The market is also taking a sanguine view of the abolition of tax relief on dividends.
